name: repo-graph
description: Map local or public git repositories with offline interactive architecture diagrams and optional Jev roles.

interface.shortDescription: Local repository graphs and architecture diagrams
interface.longDescription: Explore repository system architecture, card/tree/radial diagrams, a file-count treemap, data tables, and a dependency matrix. Offline views share bounded drilldown, sorting, filtering, CSV and SVG export, and optional Jev role labels.
